elements_not_encoded.text: Ceftriaxone1 2g IM. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site. If referral delayed, repeat dose after 12 hours.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Ceftriaxone dosing for meningitis: medicine/dose, no manage tasks in this pass.

elements_not_encoded.text: Paracetamol 500mg-1g 4-6 hourly (up to 4g in 24 hours) as needed and/or ibuprofen2 400mg 8 hourly with/after food as needed. If severe pain, also give tramadol
If patient was in malaria area in past 3 months and malaria test3 positive, also give artesunate 2.4mg/kg IM. Patient to reach referral hospital within 6 hours.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Phrased as "also give artesunate" plus referral timing and notification: treatment add-on for the meningitis/refer patient, not a separate referral criterion. Malaria-area travel and test result are not encoded (see remaining questions).

known_issues.check: CHECKED FOR BUT NEVER USED AS EVIDENCE
known_issues.reason: Gate false positive: the finding is used as (no X) in 'Urgent: same-day referral after a seizure/fit' (HIV and no known epilepsy). Because X carries a qualifier, the rendered (no ...) puts the No value before the qualifier, so the gate's NO_RE (which expects the No value last) does not strip it. Faithful encoding kept.

judgment_calls.decision: Seizure AND any of temperature >= 38, headache, stiff neck, purpuric rash -> probable meningitis
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require fever plus a meningeal sign; or all items together

judgment_calls.decision: Two probable rules (Cerebrovascular accident, Transient ischemic attack) with identical evidence
judgment_calls.alternatives: One rule for Cerebrovascular accident only; a common parent concept

judgment_calls.topic: '> 1 hour after fit' and 'up to 1 week postpartum'
judgment_calls.decision: Onset comparisons on the Seizure and Postpartum state findings
judgment_calls.alternatives: Drop the time part (fires more often)

judgment_calls.decision: Generic Muscle weakness / Numbness with Sudden onset and Asymmetry qualifiers
judgment_calls.alternatives: Body-site specific concepts (Numbness of face, Muscle weakness of limb) or Sudden onset only

judgment_calls.decision: Vasovagal syncope probable when Collapse AND Muscle twitch AND any of flushing, dizziness, nausea, sweating; '< 15 seconds' and 'rapid recovery' not modelled
Stroke/TIA and faint rules do not require (no Seizure); they rest on their own evidence and are checked from the seizure task
judgment_calls.alternatives: (no Seizure) guard, which could never be recorded alongside the trigger
